description: Plan a Highlight on an Instagram account (it goes last unless position is given). Then pass highlight_ids to post_create with kind story.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name.description: As it shows under the circle; Instagram allows 15 characters

purpose.description: What belongs in it, e.g. "Customer reviews"

refresh_days.description: Flag it when no new Story has gone in for this many days

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: highlight_create
title: Add a Highlight
